externalSourceDecision.requiredBefore: public distribution of local-crossword-001 or any derived lexicon artifact
externalSourceDecision.reason: The legacy local-crossword-001 source repository states no license. OEWN 2025 is a separately pinned source with CC-BY-4.0 stated on the official downloads page, but its staged data is unreviewed and has not been admitted into a production pack.

stagedImports.licenseEvidence: The official OEWN downloads page identifies the 2025 edition (2025-12-31) and states the resource is released under CC-BY-4.0. The exact downloaded ZIP has no ZIP comment, standalone license/notice file, or metadata/manifest member; its archive-native metadata does not itself state the license.
stagedImports.attribution: Open English Wordnet 2025 by the Open English Wordnet Community, derived from Princeton WordNet; licensed under CC BY 4.0. Attribute the source, link the license, indicate normalization/import changes, and do not imply endorsement.
stagedImports.transformation: Deterministically imported JSON lexical entries and synsets. Preserved source surfaces/gloss arrays and sense keys; emitted NFC/casefold keys; linked lexical forms and senses to synset IDs/POS. Grid-shape projection accepts 2-21 ASCII letters only; unsafe, non-grid, too-short, and too-long forms are quarantined with stable reasons. No clue generation, fact review, editorial approval, or pack admission.
stagedImports.distribution: Local staging artifact only; not an approved content pack. Reproduce with the pinned importer and keep generated corpus output out of source control.
